title: Number line to 20
examples: Teacher, if I start at 2 and jump three times, where do I land?
How do I know which number comes right after 17 on the line?

explain.say: A number line shows numbers in order. Each number has its own place.
Find seven on the line. Seven is between six and eight.
Numbers get bigger as you move to the right. Ten is further along than five. So ten is bigger.
You can jump along the line. Start at three. Jump one space, and you land on four.
Start at five and jump two spaces. You land on seven.
You can jump back to take away. Start at ten and jump back two. You land on eight.

faq.q: What does it mean to be 'between' two numbers?
faq.a: It means the number that sits right in the middle of those two numbers. For example, 8 is between 7 and 9.
asks: What number is in the middle?
What number comes after 12 and before 14?

faq.q: If I jump backwards, am I counting down?
faq.a: Yes, jumping backwards is like counting down. If you start at 10 and jump back two, you land on 8.
asks: How do I count backwards on the line?

faq.q: Can I jump more than one space at a time?
faq.a: Yes, you can jump by any number. If you jump by five from 2, you will land exactly on 7.
asks: What if I jump by three?

faq.q: Does the number line always go up to 20?
faq.a: The number line here goes up to 20. You will use bigger numbers later on.
asks: What is the biggest number on this line?

faq.q: If I order numbers, do I always start from one?
faq.a: You can order numbers either way. Usually you start with the smallest and go up to the biggest.
asks: Do I always start at the beginning?
How do I put these numbers in order?

facts: The number line shows the order of whole numbers.
Numbers increase as you move to the right on the line.
Jumping forward means adding a number.
The number before 11 is 10, and the number after 11 is 12.

quiz.say: Look at the number line. Tap the number after 13.
quiz.why: One step after thirteen is fourteen.

wrong.0: Fifteen is two steps on, so move just one step.
wrong.1: Twelve comes before thirteen, on the left.

quiz.say: Tap the numbers in order, from smallest to biggest.
quiz.why: Ten is the smallest, then eleven, then twelve. That is the order on the number line.

wrong.0: This goes from biggest to smallest, so turn it round.
wrong.2: Eleven comes before twelve on the number line.

quiz.say: Start at 5. Jump 2 spaces on. Tap where you land.
quiz.why: From five, you jump to six, then to seven.

wrong.1: Six is one jump, and you need two jumps.
wrong.2: Three is two jumps back, and these jumps go forward.
